lesson.grammar_point: passive voice in the present and past simple

listenings.text: Hi, this is an automated message from Capital Home Delivery about order number four seven two nine eight one. Your delivery is scheduled for Tuesday, between eleven in the morning and three in the afternoon. Somebody has to be home, because the boxes are not left without a signature. And just so you know, this is curbside delivery. That means the items are brought to the street or to the door of the building. They are not carried upstairs and they are not assembled. The legs and the hardware are packed inside the box. If nobody is home, the order is taken back to the warehouse and a second delivery is charged at fifty dollars. To change the window, press one, or call us back and have the order number ready. Again, that is four seven two nine eight one. Thank you.

So we moved in July and the house was completely empty. I mean empty, not even a curtain. And everything here is sold in inches, which I still cannot picture, you know? So the first thing I bought was a huge sectional sofa, and it was gorgeous, and it did not fit through the front door. Not even close. I had measured the room, but I never measured the door. Nobody tells you that. It was picked up two weeks later and I paid a hundred and eighty dollars in a restocking fee, just to give the thing back. Now I do not buy anything without a measuring tape in my hand. The dining table was backordered for six weeks, the rug was out of stock twice, and the bookcase came in four boxes and it was assembled by my husband over a whole weekend. I mean, the house is done now. It just took eight months.

Before you start, clear the floor and open every bag. Inside the box you will find an Allen key, eight bolts and four legs, and you do not need any other tool. The back panel is laid face down on a rug, never on a hard floor, because the finish is scratched very easily. The side panels are attached first, then the back, and the legs go on last. Here is the important part. Do not tighten anything all the way until the whole frame is standing. If it is tightened too early, the frame is pulled out of square and the last bolt never lines up. That is the number one call we get. And keep your paperwork. The frame is covered by a ten year warranty and the fabric by two, but nothing is covered if the piece is assembled with a power drill. Hand tighten only.
